directions.title_zh: 高效大语言/视觉语言模型
directions.intro_en: Quantization, sparsity, distillation, and token compression for large language, vision-language, and generative models, cutting compute and memory cost with little loss in capability.
directions.intro_zh: 面向大语言模型、视觉语言模型与生成模型的量化、稀疏、蒸馏与 Token 压缩方法，在几乎不损失能力的前提下降低计算与存储开销。

directions.intro_en: Fast, lightweight perception, planning, and action models for robots and agents, including vision-language-action and world action models that must run in real time on limited hardware.
directions.intro_zh: 面向机器人与智能体的轻量化感知、规划与动作模型，包括需要在受限硬件上实时运行的视觉-语言-动作模型与世界动作模型。

directions.intro_en: Systems and hardware support for efficient AI: low-bit kernels and training, KV cache and memory systems, and deployment on domestic accelerators such as Ascend NPUs.
directions.intro_zh: 为高效 AI 提供系统与硬件支撑：低比特算子与低比特训练、KV Cache 与记忆系统，以及在昇腾等国产加速器上的部署。
